paragraphs: The F-Type R575 is an extremely limited-run variant introduced near the end of the F-Type's production life, combining the 5.0-litre supercharged V8 with a 575 PS output — the most powerful non-SVR F-Type ever produced. Under the bonnet sits the AJ133, a Gen III AJ-V8 that's been the backbone of Jaguar's high-performance V8 range for over a decade. It's the same fundamental engine that powered the F-Type R and SVR, though the R575 received a final power bump and some component updates before production ended in 2024. The F-Type R575 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 5.0L V8 Petrol Supercharged engine fitted to the F-Type R575 — X152 (2013–2024).

compatibility.intro: Because the F-Type R575 uses the AJ133 V8 across its entire production run, the engine itself is consistent — but there were running changes during the X152 generation, including updates to timing chain components and water pump design.
